agentSummary: Adds tools for Motion Design Cloners and Effectors.
enablesAgentTo: Configure Cloner and Effector actors through their runtime/editor component APIs
Inspect layouts, extension objects, effector types, modes, effects, and live component state
Link and unlink effectors to cloners without using Motion Design UI panels
whenToEnable: Your project uses Motion Design Cloners and Effectors.
